# encapi_node (Resource)

Assigns a Puppet node (by certname) to a role and environment, with optional per-node parameter overrides.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "encapi_node" "example" {
  certname    = "node01.example.com"
  role        = "roles::infra::storage::vault"
  environment = "testing"

  # Optional per-node overrides (win over the role's default_params).
  params = jsonencode({
    vault_role = "leader"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certname` (String) Puppet certname (fqdn) of the host.
- `environment` (String) Environment/status. Must reference an existing encapi_status.
- `role` (String) Role/class to assign. Must reference an existing encapi_role.

### Optional

- `params` (String) Per-node parameter overrides as a JSON object. Use jsonencode({...}) to preserve value types. These override the role's default_params.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by certname.
terraform import encapi_node.example node01.example.com
```
